rows.name: value
rows.description: Controlled value, or null for no selection.

rows.name: onChange
rows.description: Fired with the new date (or null when the input is cleared).

rows.name: display
rows.description: Text input + popover calendar, an always-visible inline calendar, or a trigger button that opens the calendar in a modal with Apply / Cancel.

rows.name: minDate
rows.description: Earliest selectable date (inclusive). Out-of-range days are disabled.

rows.name: rangeError
rows.description: Message shown when an out-of-range date is typed (popover).
